provenance.equation: T_cell = (abs(n dot u) + abs(n dot v)) / spread_rate_m_s + T_point
provenance.equation_origin: geometric projection of affine-cell vertices; explicit package model assumption
provenance.meaning: whole-cell emission duration from first front entry until last-point front flame extinction

point_residence_time.source: latest documented reference point residence 11.52 s (SAV 2000 ft^-1), documents/heat_parameter_models.md
point_residence_time.scope: reference scenario, not Korean fuel evidence

default_spread_rate_reference.title: The Portuguese Large Wildfire Spread database (PT-FireSprd)
default_spread_rate_reference.reported_statistic: median reconstructed forward rate of spread
default_spread_rate_reference.population: spread observations from 80 large mainland Portuguese wildfires, 2015-2021
default_spread_rate_reference.scope: reference scenario; not a universal speed or a Fish Creek measurement

provenance.direction_convention: counterclockwise degrees from projected +x; advancing front normal; not wind bearing
provenance.front_assumption: straight front with constant normal direction and positive constant speed within each cell
provenance.arrival_semantics: first cell entry/burn start; supplied arrivals are not interpreted as center arrivals
provenance.emission_profile: uniform whole-cell rectangular pulse on [arrival, arrival + T_cell)
provenance.energy_policy: fixed supplied phase-consumed mass times heat yield; conditional HRR divided by T_cell; total phase energy preserved

sources.supported_role: defines residence as front flaming time at a stationary fuel point; does not provide cell crossing duration
distinguishes post-frontal flaming and smoldering combustion from perimeter spread; does not supply this geometric crossing law

limitations: spread speed and direction are explicit supplied scenarios, not inferred observations
cell occupancy duration differs from point flame residence
uniform rectangular emission does not resolve time-varying burning fraction or moving subcell flame geometry
no automatic trailing, smoldering, reignition, or crown-combustion extension
reconstructed arrival data do not establish actual first-cell-entry time

trajectory_seed_semantics: trajectory_seed[k] = int64 view of SeedSequence([seed, cutoff=0, block=k//batch, stream=0]) (rollout._generator ignition stream of the block); trajectory k is row k % batch

trajectory_first_burn_hour_coding.1..H: first burned at that whole hour
trajectory_first_burn_hour_coding.-2: state unknown (never recorded burned and outside the rollout coverage envelope at the horizon)
